As reported in the earlier quarter, please note that subsequent to the Scheme of Amalgamation effecting merger of Ram Ratna Research and Holdings Private Limited (RRRHPL) and Jag-Bid Finvest Private Limited (JBFPL) into Hemlata Home Solutions Private Limited (HHSPL), HHSPL was converted into a Limited Liability Partnership under the name Hemlata Home Solutions LLP (HHS LLP) with effect from 27 January 2026. However, the name of HHSPL continues to appear as a Promoter Group member in the beneficial position (BENPOS) data as of 30 June 2026, as the process of updating the name to HHS LLP in one of its demat accounts (relating to JBFPL) is still ongoing. HHSPLs name is therefore reflected in the shareholding pattern pursuant to the BENPOS data, pending its name change in the depository system.
During the reporting quarter, Shri Shreegopal Kabra, a Promoter member transferred 4,00,000 equity shares to his grandson, Master Dev Kabra through gift and consequently, pursuant to Regulation 31A(6) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, Master Dev Kabra has been classified as a member of the Promoter Group.
As per the information provided to the Company, Mr. Hemant Kabra and Mrs. Sarita Jhawar, members of the Promoter Group, sold 4,00,000 and 2,00,000 equity shares respectively on 30 June 2026. However, due to the T+1 settlement mechanism, the effect of these transactions was not reflected in the BENPOS for the quarter ended 30 June 2026. Accordingly, the shareholding of the said promoter group members have been disclosed in this Shareholding Pattern based on the BENPOS and the shareholding data received from the RTA as of 30 June 2026. However, after factoring the aforementioned sale of shares dated 30 June 202t, the aggregate shareholding of Promoter & Promoter Group will be 6,88,26,196 shares representing 60.85% of the total equity share capital.
